subject.title: WhatsApp: support pre-built link previews in sendMessage + batch send RPC method

question: Which scope should OpenClaw accept for this issue: staged pre-built WhatsApp linkPreview pass-through only, full automatic-preview plus batch Gateway design, or no core/plugin change?
rationale: The pass-through is dependency-supported and narrow, but automatic URL fetching and a new batch RPC are security and protocol choices that source inspection cannot settle without maintainer intent.

options.title: Stage pass-through first
options.body: Implement only the typed pre-built linkPreview pass-through now and leave automatic fetching plus batch RPC for separately reviewed designs.

options.title: Design full scope together
options.body: Keep all three requested capabilities together and require a broader protocol/security design before implementation.

options.title: Decline core/plugin change
options.body: Reject these additions for OpenClaw-owned WhatsApp/Gateway surfaces and keep custom batching or preview workflows outside supported APIs.

recommendation.title: Stage pass-through first
recommendation.body: Implement only the typed pre-built linkPreview pass-through now and leave automatic fetching plus batch RPC for separately reviewed designs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already consolidated the narrower WhatsApp link-preview report into this broader tracker, making him the strongest available routing signal for the scope decision.
